dialogue.content: 入りました。今日はよろしくお願いいたします。。
dialogue.English: I've joined. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: (お待たせしました！よろしくお願いいたします)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for waiting! It's a pleasure to speak with you.)

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Likewise, thank you.

dialogue.content: (はじめられますか？)
dialogue.English: (Shall we begin?)

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm ready.

dialogue.content: (始めますね)
dialogue.English: (Okay, let's begin.)

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: はい、中2の息子の事で困っています。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm having some trouble with my son, who's in the 8th grade.

dialogue.content: 息子さんの事…それは心配になりますね。
dialogue.English: Your son... I can understand why you'd be concerned.

dialogue.content: よろしければ、初めに年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？(言えたらで大丈夫です)
dialogue.English: If it's alright, may I ask your age and gender to start? (Only if you feel comfortable sharing.)

dialogue.content: はい。45歳、女です。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm a 45-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 息子さんの事とは…どんな事で悩まれているのですか？
dialogue.English: Regarding your son... what specifically has been troubling you?

dialogue.content: コロナで休校の時期があったりしたあと、
dialogue.English: After the school closures due to COVID,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ゲームをする時間が長くなっているみたいで、寝てるのも遅いみたいなんです。
dialogue.English: It seems he's been spending more time playing video games, and going to bed late.

dialogue.content: でも、聞くとうるせえとか言われてしまい
dialogue.English: But when I ask him about it, he just says things like, "You're annoying."

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 話しかけても、うるさそうにされるので、
dialogue.English: Even when I try to talk to him, he acts annoyed, so...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: よくわからなくて
dialogue.English: I don't really know what's going on.

dialogue.content: なんか、イライラしてるみたいです。
dialogue.English: He just seems irritated all the time.

dialogue.content: うんうん、それは息子さんのご体調や気持ちが心配になりますよね
dialogue.English: I see. That must make you worry about your son's health and how he's feeling.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.content: よく分からないというのは、息子さんがゲームをしているかどうかということですか？
dialogue.English: When you say you don't know what's going on, do you mean you're not sure if he's playing games or not?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: なんか、部屋にこもっているし
dialogue.English: He's always holed up in his room.

dialogue.content: そうですか…もっとお話ししたいですよね
dialogue.English: I see... You want to be able to talk with him more, don't you?

dialogue.content: はい。今日学校楽しかった？とか聞いても、別に、とかふつう、とか
dialogue.English: Yes. Even if I ask something like, "Did you have fun at school today?", he just says, "Not really," or "It was okay."

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: なんか、取り付く島がなくて。
dialogue.English: It's like there's no way to get through to him.

dialogue.content: そう答えるんですね…
dialogue.English: So that's how he responds...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですか…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 寂しくなりますよね。。
dialogue.English: That must feel lonely.

dialogue.content: はい、なんか寂しいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it does feel lonely.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。
dialogue.English: I can understand that.

dialogue.content: 休校前はどんな様子だったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What was he like before the school closures?

dialogue.content: それほどゲームにはまっていたとも思わなかったので、
dialogue.English: I don't think he was that into games back then,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 休校中に時間があって、なんかくせになっちゃったのかなーとか。
dialogue.English: During the closures he had time, and I wonder if it kind of became a habit.

dialogue.content: うんうん、なるほどですね
dialogue.English: Uh-huh, that makes sense.

dialogue.content: 前は部屋からよく出てきて、夜お茶したりもしたんですけど。
dialogue.English: He used to come out of his room often, and we'd sometimes have tea together at night.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 最近は部屋に入ったきりで、声かけてもめんどくさそうにされます。
dialogue.English: But lately, he just stays in his room, and when I call out to him, he acts annoyed.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…。それは息子さんとの時間が減って気持ちが通じ合っていない感じがして悲しくなってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see... It must be sad to feel like you're spending less time with your son and that you're not connecting with each other.

dialogue.content: そうてすね。
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: このことはどなたかにご相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to anyone else about this?

dialogue.content: そうですね。夫には話したのですが、
dialogue.English: Well, I talked to my husband about it, but...

dialogue.content: 夫はあまり心配してないみたいでした。
dialogue.English: he didn't seem too worried.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それは自分だけ悩んでいるようで、もどかしいですよね
dialogue.English: That must be frustrating, feeling like you're the only one worrying about this.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね。
dialogue.English: It is.

dialogue.content: うんうん。ご確認ですが、今、あなた(なんとお呼びしますか？)のお話を聞いて、ゲームをやめさせることでもっと関わりたいとの気持ちが伝わってきましたが…いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Let me just confirm, as I listen to you (and please tell me, how should I address you?), I get the sense you want him to cut back on gaming so you can connect with him more. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: 優子です。そうですね。
dialogue.English: My name is Yuko. Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 優子さんですね。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yuko-san, thank you.

dialogue.content: 夜のゲームとか、あまり体によくなさそうで、心配なのです。
dialogue.English: I'm worried that playing games late at night isn't good for his health.

dialogue.content: でも、言うこと聞いてくれそうにないし。
dialogue.English: But it doesn't seem like he'll listen to anything I say.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうですよね。それでしたらこのご相談では、ゲームを少しでも減らして、息子さんと関わるためには？ということを一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: I understand. In that case, in this session, let's think together about how you can reduce his gaming time, even just a little, and connect more with your son.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'd appreciate that.

dialogue.content: はい、こちらこそお願いします。ええ、話しかけて息子さんに怖い口調で言われると嫌ですよね。
dialogue.English: Of course, I'd be glad to. Yes, it must be upsetting when you try to talk to your son and he responds in such a harsh tone.

dialogue.content: とっても嫌です。
dialogue.English: It's very upsetting.

dialogue.content: ええ、本当にそうだと思います。日常生活で息子さんと関わるときはどんなときですか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I completely understand. In your daily life, when do you usually interact with your son?

dialogue.content: 共働きなので、帰ってきて夕食を取るとき、です。
dialogue.English: We both work, so it's when I get home and we have dinner.

dialogue.content: 夫のが遅いので基本2人です。
dialogue.English: My husband gets home late, so it's usually just the two of us.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね。その時はどんなお話をするのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What kinds of things do you talk about then?

dialogue.content: 最近なんか、不機嫌というか、つっかかってくるので
dialogue.English: Lately, he's been sort of grumpy, or combative, so...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 何を話したらいいかわからなくなってしまって
dialogue.English: I've started to not know what to say to him.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: (お話しくださいね)
dialogue.English: (Please feel free to share.)

dialogue.content: 学校のこととか聞いても、別に、で終わってしまうし
dialogue.English: Even if I ask about school, he just says, "Nothing special," and that's the end of it.

dialogue.content: ああ…
dialogue.English: Ah...

dialogue.content: 困っています
dialogue.English: I'm at a loss.

dialogue.content: そっかぁ…それはきついですね
dialogue.English: I see... that must be tough.

dialogue.content: はい。きついです。
dialogue.English: Yes. It's tough.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…本当にそうだと思います…。息子さんは、お父さんとはいかがですか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine... I really do... How is your son with his father?

dialogue.content: 主人とは、まぁ仲良しかなと思います。
dialogue.English: With my husband, I think they get along fairly well.

dialogue.content: そうですか…それも優子さんから見ると寂しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see... That must also make you feel lonely, Yuko-san.

dialogue.content: 自分とも話してほしいのに…と思いますよね。
dialogue.English: You must be thinking, "I wish he would talk to me like that..."

dialogue.content: そうですね。異性なのでわかりにくいところもあるし
dialogue.English: That's true. Since we're different genders, there are things that are hard to understand.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいんだ？っておもって。
dialogue.English: I find myself thinking, 'What should I do?'

dialogue.content: ええ、そう思うのも無理はないです。一緒にかんがえましょう。ここまでのお話をまとめさせていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Yes, it's completely understandable to feel that way. Let's think about it together. May I summarize what I've heard so far?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 優子さんは、息子さんが休校明けから夜遅くまでゲームをしていることに心配されています。また、関わることも減って寂しい思いをされています。
dialogue.English: Yuko-san, you're concerned about your son playing games late into the night since school started back up. You're also feeling lonely because you're interacting with him less.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 以前はお茶を飲みに出てきていたのに、今はお部屋にいることが多く、話しかけてもうるさいと言われて困ってらっしゃいますね。
dialogue.English: He used to come out for tea, but now he mostly stays in his room, and when you speak to him, he says you're being annoying, which you find troubling.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 自分にはそういう態度なのに…お父様とは仲が良く、夕飯も二人でお話にあまり答えてくれず、取り付く島がないと感じてらっしゃいます。
dialogue.English: Even though he acts that way with you... he gets along well with his father, and during dinner for two, he doesn't respond much, leaving you feeling like you can't get through to him.

dialogue.content: はい、なんか寂しいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it just feels lonely.

dialogue.content: そうですよね…お気持ち伝わってきます。
dialogue.English: I understand... I can really feel how you’re feeling.

dialogue.content: あなたは休校明けから寂しさを我慢しながらも、息子さんに話しかけ続け
dialogue.English: Since school reopened, even while enduring this loneliness, you've continued to try to talk to your son,

dialogue.content: 本当に息子さんを愛してらっしゃるのだと思いました
dialogue.English: and I can tell you truly love him.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: I suppose so.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 憎らしいですが。
dialogue.English: He can be infuriating, though.

dialogue.content: 色々心配してしまいます。
dialogue.English: I just worry about so many things.

dialogue.content: ええ。そういう気持ちもおありなんですよね。お話を伺って思ったことをお伝えしてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Yes. It's natural to feel that way too. May I share a thought I had while listening to you?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Certainly.

dialogue.content: 優子さんは本当にご家族思いのお優しい方なのだと思いました
dialogue.English: I felt that you, Yuko-san, are a very kind person who cares deeply for your family.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 息子さんの体調や気持ちも心配したり、寂しい気持ちをもちながらも、夕食をご一緒されていますね
dialogue.English: You worry about your son's health and feelings, and even though you feel lonely, you still have dinner with him.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 息子さんによっては心強い存在だと思います
dialogue.English: I believe you are a reassuring presence for your son.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: そうだといいです。
dialogue.English: I hope so.

dialogue.content: そうですね、どう思われますか？
dialogue.English: Yes—how do you feel about that?

dialogue.content: うーん。うるさがられてるのかなと。
dialogue.English: Hmm. I feel like he just finds me annoying.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そう思われるのも無理ないです。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, it's understandable to feel that way.

dialogue.content: もしかしたら、言葉と気持ちとは裏腹な部分もあるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: It's possible that his words and his feelings don't always align.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ここからはご提案なのですが、おつたえしていいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I have a suggestion—may I share it?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: お話を聞いていて、中学二年生という時期はお母さんに反抗したい時期でもあると思いました。優子さんも言っていたように、異性より同性の親と話が盛り上がる時期なのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Listening to you, it occurred to me that the second year of middle school is often a time when boys want to rebel against their mothers. As you mentioned, it might also be a time when it's easier to talk to the parent of the same gender.

dialogue.content: お父さんにも相談したけど、あんまりな反応だったとのことですが、
dialogue.English: You mentioned you spoke with your husband but he wasn't very responsive,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 共働きとのことなので、お休みの日に環境を変えてどこかにお出かけして、そこで三人で今の優子さんの気持ち…じっくりお話ししてみるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Since you both work, how about changing the environment on a day off, perhaps going somewhere, and the three of you have a thorough talk about how you're feeling right now, Yuko-san?

dialogue.content: お休みの日に、ですね。なるほど。
dialogue.English: On a day off, I see. That makes sense.

dialogue.content: うまく言えるかな・・
dialogue.English: I wonder if I can express it well...

dialogue.content: ええ、心配になりますよね。行く前に夫さんに
dialogue.English: Yes, that's a natural concern. Before you go, tell your husband,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 【悩んでいる事をお話しする時間】を作るためにお出かけしたいと、お話しするのがポイントです
dialogue.English: The key is to tell him that you want to go on this outing to make time to "talk about what's been worrying you."

dialogue.content: なるほど。先に伝えておくんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So I should tell him in advance.

dialogue.content: 心理学で【レディネス】という言葉があります。お話をする【心構え】をしてもらって夫さんに味方になってもらって、お話し進めてみるといいと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: In psychology, there's a term called "readiness." I think it would be good to get your husband mentally prepared for the conversation, have him on your side, and then move forward with the discussion.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。わかりました！ちなみに子供には、どんな伝え方なら、受け取ってもらえるでしょう。
dialogue.English: I see. I understand! By the way, how should I approach it with my son so that he'll be receptive?

dialogue.content: ええ、お伝えしますね
dialogue.English: Certainly, let me share some ideas.

dialogue.content: お願いします。
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: 優子さんが、息子さんの素敵だなと思うところはありますか？
dialogue.English: Yuko-san, are there things you find wonderful about your son?

dialogue.content: 素敵・・うーん。
dialogue.English: Wonderful... hmm.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 友達は多いみたいです。
dialogue.English: He seems to have a lot of friends.

dialogue.content: おお、なるほどですね！
dialogue.English: Oh, that's great!

dialogue.content: あと、結構物知りです。
dialogue.English: Also, he's quite knowledgeable.

dialogue.content: お友達にはどんな部分が好きになってもらっているんですかね？
dialogue.English: I wonder what it is about him that his friends like?

dialogue.content: 物知り、いいですね
dialogue.English: Being knowledgeable is a great quality.

dialogue.content: よく話して面白いって言われるみたいです。
dialogue.English: Apparently, they say he's interesting to talk to and funny.

dialogue.content: へぇ！
dialogue.English: Wow!

dialogue.content: そうですか、それでしたら
dialogue.English: I see. In that case,

dialogue.content: 「お母さんは物知りで友達も多い○○の事すごいなぁと思うし、いつも大切に思っている」
dialogue.English: 'Mom thinks it's amazing how you're so knowledgeable and have so many friends, and I always care about you.'

dialogue.content: といいところからお伝えして
dialogue.English: Start by sharing the good things,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: でも最近お母さん寂しく思っている、理由は○○
dialogue.English: and then, 'But lately, Mom has been feeling lonely, and the reason is...'

dialogue.content: と優子さんの正直な気持ちをお伝えするといいと思います
dialogue.English: I think it would be good to share your honest feelings like that.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: なるほどです。
dialogue.English: That makes sense.

dialogue.content: 話せそうな気がしてきました。
dialogue.English: I feel like I might be able to have that conversation now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: おお、よかったです。あと、ゲームですが
dialogue.English: Oh, I'm so glad to hear that. Also, regarding the gaming...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お父さんと三人で約束を作るといいと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I think it would be a good idea for the three of you—you, your husband, and your son—to make a rule together.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That's a good idea.

dialogue.content: ３人で約束ですね。
dialogue.English: A rule made by the three of us.

dialogue.content: 例えば一時間とか。ポイントは息子さんが【自分で決める】です
dialogue.English: For example, one hour a day. The key point is that your son gets to "decide for himself."

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: わかりました。夫とも相談してみます。
dialogue.English: I understand. I'll talk it over with my husband.

dialogue.content: ええ、是非相談してみて下さいね！ご家族思いの優子さんのお話し、お二人ともきっと聞いてくれますよ、心からおうえんしています！
dialogue.English: Yes, please do! I'm sure both of them will listen to what you have to say, Yuko-san, as you care so much for your family. I'm cheering for you with all my heart!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Thank you so much!

dialogue.content: 今日はお話ししてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel after talking today?

dialogue.content: なんか明るい気持ちになってきました。
dialogue.English: I'm starting to feel more positive.

dialogue.content: 前向きに考えてみます。
dialogue.English: I'll try to think about it positively.

dialogue.content: 優子さんの未来心から応援しています！またどうなったか教えてくださいね。本日はご相談に来ていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I'm rooting for your future, Yuko-san! Please let me know how things go. Thank you very much for coming in for counseling today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: No, thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは終了のメッセージを送らせていただきます
dialogue.English: I'll send the closing message now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました！)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much!)

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。とても勉強になりました！
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. This was very helpful!

dialogue.content: (４分すぎちゃいましたね…すみません。終了しますね)
dialogue.English: (Oh, we went four minutes over... sorry about that. I'll end the session now.)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそです！)
dialogue.English: (My pleasure!)

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です！
dialogue.English: No problem!

dialogue.content: (それでは失礼します)
dialogue.English: (Well then, goodbye.)

dialogue.content: お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.
